# Text Entry on Smartwatches: Challenges and Research Findings

Smartwatches face significant challenges in text entry due to limited screen space.

## Popularity and Limitations of Smartwatches
- **Popularity:** Smartwatches have gained attention from the public and researchers.
- **Text Entry Challenges:** Limited screen space makes text entry difficult.
- **Lack of Support:** Many smartwatches (e.g., Apple Watch, MOTO 360) do not support text entry.
- **Few Options:** Only a few models (e.g., Microsoft Band, Samsung Gear S2) feature built-in keyboards.

---

## Research on Text Entry Techniques
- **Input Techniques:** Most proposed techniques focus on character-level input (e.g., Zoomboard, Oney et al., 2013; ZShift, Leiva et al., 2015).
- **Word-Level Input:** Important for modern software keyboards; allows for predictive text entry.
- **Touch Model Studies:** Many studies quantify touch input characteristics, primarily on smartphones.
- **Knowledge Gap:** No empirical results exist for touch point distribution on smartwatches.

---

## Studies Conducted on Tiny QWERTY Keyboards
- **Objective:** Explore feasibility of high-performance text entry algorithms on smartwatches.
- **Study 1:** 
  - **Participants:** 20 participants collected typing data.
  - **Input Rate:** Achieved 21.4 to 24.8 words per minute (WPM) with high precision despite touch point offsets.
  
- **Study 2:** 
  - **Algorithm Performance:** Evaluated a naive Bayesian algorithm from Study 1 data.
  - **Input Rate:** Participants achieved 32.6 WPM with a 0.6% character error rate on a 3.0 cm keyboard.
  - **Keyboard Size Impact:** Larger keyboards (3.5 and 4.0 cm) did not significantly improve performance.

- **Study 3:** 
  - **Real Smartwatch Testing:** Replicated tests on a smartwatch to verify assumptions from previous studies.
  - **Results Consistency:** Confirmed that smartphone results apply to smartwatches regarding speed, accuracy, and user ratings.

---

## Error Correction and Model Simulation
- **Simulation Conducted:** Compared error correction abilities of different touch/language models using Study 1 data.
- **Findings:** 
  - **Error Rate:** Achieved top-1 error rate below 8% using bigram language or detailed touch models.
  - **Implications:** Incorporating powerful language models and improving touch behavior modeling can enhance text entry performance.

The research highlights the potential for improved text entry methods on smartwatches through effective modeling and algorithm development.

# Arriving in Singapore: Procedures and Requirements

Upon arrival in Singapore, follow specific procedures for immigration and customs clearance.

## Immigration and Health Declaration
- **Health Declaration:** Submit the **electronic Health Declaration Card (eHDC)** via the [SG Arrival Card (SGAC) e-Service](https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/sgarrivalcard) before immigration.
- **Discontinuation of Paper Cards:** Paper-based disembarkation and embarkation cards for foreign visitors have been discontinued since 27 March 2020.
- **Documents Required:** Long-term Pass Holders and Foreign Visitors must have passports and Permits/Entry Visas ready.  
- **Yellow Fever Certificate:** Present a Fever Vaccination Certificate if arriving within six days from Yellow Fever endemic areas.  
- For the latest travel information, visit the [Covid-19 Information Hub](https://www.changiairport.com/en/airport-guide/Covid-19.html).  
*Ensure all health and immigration requirements are met upon arrival.*

---

## Customs Clearance
**Do I need to declare goods in my baggage?**
- If no controlled goods, use the **Green Channel**; if in doubt, use the **Red Channel**.
- **Baggage Inspection:** Officers may inspect baggage regardless of the channel chosen.
- **Currency Reporting:** Report amounts over S$20,000 or equivalent in foreign currency at the Red Channel.  
- For more details, visit [here](http://www.changiairport.com/en/airport-guide/departing.html).  
*Customs procedures depend on the goods you carry and the channel you choose.*

---

## Flight Information
- **Online Access:** Check flight [arrivals](http://www.changiairport.com/en/flights/arrivals.html) and [departures](http://www.changiairport.com/en/flights/departures.html) online.
- **Mobile App:** Download the free iChangi app for flight updates.
- **Information Counters:** Flight Information TVs are available at all terminals; approach Information Counters for assistance.  
*Multiple resources are available for checking flight status.*

---

## Duty-Free Allowances
- **Eligibility:** Travellers over 18, arriving from non-Malaysian countries, and spent 48 hours outside Singapore can claim duty-free liquor concessions.
- **Concessions Include:**
  - 1 litre Spirits and 1 litre Wine
  - 1 litre Spirits and 1 litre Beer
  - 1 litre Wine and 1 litre Beer
  - 2 litres Wine
  - 2 litres Beer  
*Duty-free allowances vary based on travel history and age.*

---

## Visa Requirements
**Which nationalities require a Visa to enter Singapore?**
- For entry requirements, visit [here](https://www.ica.gov.sg/visitor/visitor_entryvisa).  
*Visa requirements depend on nationality and travel purpose.*

---

## Fever Vaccination Certificate
- **Requirement:** Present a Fever Vaccination Certificate if arriving from Yellow Fever endemic areas within six days.
- **Consequences of Non-Presentation:** If unable to provide the certificate, vaccination will be required at a charge.  
*Vaccination documentation is crucial for certain arrivals.*

---

## Mascot Welcoming
- **Approval Needed:** Requests to welcome guests with a mascot must be approved by Changi Airport Group.
- **Details Required for Approval:**
  - Purpose of mascot
  - Size and dimension
  - Date & time of arrival
  - Background music
  - Filming/photography details
  - Number of arriving passengers
  - Number of staff escorting the mascot
  - Any banners
  - Route of mascot  
*Approval is necessary for mascot-related welcomes at the airport.*

---

## Currency Regulations
- **Maximum Currency:** Report amounts over S$20,000 or equivalent in foreign currency at the Customs Red Channel upon arrival and departure.  
*Currency reporting is mandatory for large amounts.*

---

## Customs Channels
- **Green Channel:** Use if no controlled goods or duty-free limits exceeded.
- **Red Channel:** Use if declaring goods or uncertain about items.  
*Choose the appropriate channel based on your baggage contents.*

---

## Prohibited Goods
- **Reference:** For a list of controlled and prohibited goods, visit [this link](https://www.customs.gov.sg/businesses/importing-goods/controlled-and-prohibited-goods-for-import).  
*Awareness of prohibited items is essential for compliance.*

---

## Waiting Areas
- **Public Areas:** You may wait for arriving relatives, friends, or family members in any public area within Changi Airport.  
*Convenient waiting options are available at the airport.*
